steps.instruction: Your previous attempt failed. Replace it as follows. Maintain the raw backing list in `_items` in insertion order and never reorder it. On every mutation (add, remove, toggleWatched), rebuild the exposed signal value with an explicit two-pass filter/concat — NOT Array.prototype.sort: `const all = rawItems.map(...); const unwatched = all.filter(i => !i.watched); const watched = all.filter(i => i.watched); setItems([...unwatched, ...watched]);`. In toggleWatched(id): map over the raw list, produce a NEW object `{ ...it, watched: !it.watched }` only for the matching id, and verify with the given tests: (1) add 1,2,3, toggleWatched(2) -> items() ids [1,3,2]; (2) add 1,2,3, toggleWatched(1) then toggleWatched(3) -> ids [2,1,3]; (3) after toggleWatched on an unwatched item, that item's watched MUST become true (component tests assert this); (4) toggling again sets it back to false; (5) order within each group is insertion order, never reversed. If items() is currently derived by sorting or by pushing toggled items to a back array, remove that logic entirely. Do not change the exported interface.
